message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are present on any incoming data in the shown code paths.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths (glob, pickle files) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication visible in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline loads and passes datasets directly to the Evaluator and detectors without any outlier filtering, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on the training data.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded in this code; models are instantiated fresh and trained, with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions present.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any adversarial robustness stress testing in the evaluation code; only synthetic anomaly variations (pollution, missing data, extreme values) are tested.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or other explicit protections against metric manipulation; results are computed and stored with no integrity verification.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation or schema checks are performed on datasets or inference inputs before passing them to detectors; data is loaded and used directly.

No detected output bounds checks: The evaluator computes metrics and plots results but there are no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity checks on model output scores before they are used.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The models used (AutoEncoder, DAGMM, LSTMAD, LSTMED, RecurrentEBM) are time-series anomaly detectors, not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
